_about: The shot list of the three-minute demonstration (docs/submission/demo_script.md): one story in six beats. A beat that ran on staging program ids carries the `staging` caption, and one that ran in the local simulator carries `simulator`; `web/upgrades.json` and docs/MANIFEST.md have the live state, read on the day. `kind` is live (it happens while it is recorded) or replay (a run made earlier is shown). `faster` is true when the shot is played faster than it happened. A replay carries the first caption and a faster shot the second, each for the shot's whole length; N is the speed measured when the shot is cut, and it is written into the caption then. Render a storyboard of it with `python scripts/video/render.py <file> --limit 180`. tests/test_business_docs.py holds this file to the script.
